title: Modifié Sgarbossa's critères pour MI dans Left Bundle Branch Block
abbreviations: Modified Sgarbossa's Criteria for MI in Left Bundle Branch Block, Modified Sgarbossa's Criteria for MI, Sgarbossa's Criteria for MI in Left Bundle Branch Block, sgarbossa LBBB, sgarbossa MI, sgarbossa, sgarbossa MI LBBB, sgarbossa STEMI, sgarbossa MI calc, sgarbossa stemi calc, sgarbossa LBB calc, sgarbossa score, sgarbossa criteria, MI calc, stemi calc, stemi risk, MI LBBB risk score, MI LBB risk calc, left bundle branch block calc, left bundle branch block sgarbossa, left bundle branch block MI, left bundle branch block ACS calc, left bundle branch block criteria MI, Sgarbossa ACS, Sgarbossa ACS calc, Sgarbossa ACS criteria
formula: Les critères de Sgarbossa modifiés sont remplis si l'un des critères est positif.

how_to_use.why:
- Améliore la sensibilité par rapport aux [critères de Sgarbossa](nabda:calc.sgarbossas-criteria-mi-left-bundle-branch-block) originaux, en particulier pour détecter une occlusion coronarienne aiguë dans les présentations ECG difficiles.
- Facilite la détection précoce des modifications is
how_to_use.when: Indiqué chez les patients chez qui l’on suspecte un infarctus du myocarde (MI) et qui présentent un bloc de branche gauche (LBBB) sous-jacent ou un rythme ventriculaire stimulé, situations dans lesquelles les modifications typiques du segment ST sont difficiles à interpréter.
how_to_use.pearls: The presence of any criterion demonstrates approximately 80% sensitivity and 99% specificity for identifying acute MI in the setting of known LBBB.

next_steps.advice:
- **Positive result:** Strongly consider initiating standard MI treatment, including immediate reperfusion therapy options (e.g., PCI), based on clinical context and in consultation with cardiology.
- **Negative result:** If MI suspicion remains, pursue further assessment with serial ECGs, cardiac biomarkers, and potentially imaging (e.g., echocardiography to evaluate wall motion abnormalities).
- This tool is best applied alongside clinical judgment, specialist input, and additional indicators, such as cardiac biomarkers.
- Sensitivity may improve with serial ECGs or comparison to previous ECGs.

medium_description: Diagnoses aigu MI chez les patients avec prior LBBB.

input_schema.name: discordant_st_elevation
input_schema.label: ST Elevation at J-point, relative pour QRS onset, is at least 1 mm AND has amplitude at least 25% de preceding S-wave
input_schema.tips: An ST/S ratio of 0.20 is also very high and almost as specific as a 0.25 ratio
